lines.en: : Guys, I don’t want to be here.
lines.zh: : 各位，我不想待在这儿。

lines.en: : Nonsense, Sensei! Just ‘cause you’re embarrassed to sing don’t mean ya gotta worry in front’a two of your best friends in the whole world.
lines.zh: : 胡说什么呢，Sensei！你只是不好意思唱歌，犯不着在全天下你最好的两个朋友面前犯怵啊。

lines.en: : That’s right, Sensei! I’m not a very good singer either, but if you won’t judge me, I won’t judge you!
lines.zh: : 就是啊，Sensei！我唱歌也不怎么好，不过你要是不嫌弃我，我也不会嫌弃你！

lines.en: : In fact, even if you did judge me, I probably wouldn’t judge you- because judging people is rude when you can never truly understand what’s going on inside of a person.
lines.zh: : 事实上，就算你嫌弃我，我大概也不会嫌弃你——因为评判别人是件很无礼的事，毕竟你永远无法真正了解一个人心里在想什么。

lines.en: {i}Right now, there are a lot of things going on inside me.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}此时此刻，我体内正发生着很多事。{/i}

lines.en: {i}For one, the pizza I ate earlier is being broken down into enzymes by the factory workers I swallowed when I was a child.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}其一，我刚才吃的披萨，正被我小时候吞下去的工厂工人分解成酶。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And the railway workers who control my vascular system are currently pulling levers and moving tracks around so more blood gets sent down to my penis to make it hard.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而那些掌管我血管系统的铁路工人，此刻正在拉杆、扳道岔，好让更多血液流向我的阴茎，让它变硬。{/i}
停下。

lines.en: {i}But I don’t want a penis because I’m a little baby bitch boy who believes in CONSENT but conveniently forgets every single day just who can do that and who can’t. Right, buddy?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可我不想要阴茎，因为我是个相信「同意」的小宝宝婊子男孩，却每天都顺手就忘掉谁有资格说同意、谁没有。对吧，老兄？{/i}
停下。

lines.en: {i}Take it out and smack them with it! Show these ladies a good time before I have to do it for you!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}掏出来抽她们啊！趁我还没替你动手，先让这几位女士开心开心！{/i}
: 我得走了。

lines.en: : Ain’t no leavin’ now that we’re here, Sensei! Ya gotta stay for at least one song. Them’s are the rules of Karaoke-town. Conveniently located right next to Bonerville.
lines.zh: : 来都来了还走什么呀，Sensei！至少得待到唱完一首。这可是卡拉 OK 城的规矩。它位置正好就在 Bonerville 旁边。

lines.en: {i}Those towns are a lot closer than she thinks LOL{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那两座城比她以为的近多了 哈哈哈{/i}
我不想——

lines.en: {i}Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah! That’s what you sound like right now. Pussy. Baby-back bitch. Just give in and listen to the MUSIC, frog boy! You love this song! It reminds you of the-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哇————————————！你现在听起来就是这样。怂包。软蛋婊子。认命吧，乖乖听音-乐，青蛙小子！你最爱这首歌了！它让你想起那个——{/i}

lines.en: {i}The fuckin’...what’s her name again? Mayonnaise Macaroni? The closet nympho who ISN’T related to Sara.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那个他妈的……她叫什么来着？蛋黄酱通心粉？那个跟 Sara 没有血缘关系的深柜色情狂。{/i}
你怎么知道 Sara 的？

lines.en: {i}I know everybody. But I only remember my favorites. Like her and the, uhh...wait, no. You guys never met. But hey, what are you talking to me for? It’s time to sing, bitch.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我谁都认识。但我只记得我最喜欢的那些。比如她，还有那个，呃……等等，不对。你们根本没见过。不过话说回来，你跟我搭什么话？该唱歌了，贱人。{/i}
: 有什么不对劲吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : {s}Yes.{/s} No, I’m okay. I just get nervous easily.
lines.zh: : {s}有{/s}。没有，我没事。我只是很容易紧张。

lines.en: I attempt to pull myself away from the girls but can’t bring myself to move my limbs.
lines.zh: 我试图从两个女孩身边抽身，却怎么也指挥不动自己的四肢。

lines.en: {i}Naaaaah, you just don’t want to leave. Stop blaming this on me. Fuck ‘em. Win the “game.”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}才——不是呢，你就是不想走。别赖在我头上。操他们的。去赢这场「游戏」。{/i}

lines.en: : How ‘bout I go first then? I ain’t much of a singer either. Chances are you’ll feel way better ‘bout all this after I get a turn. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那我先来怎么样？我唱得也不怎么样。等我唱完一轮，你们八成会觉得好受多了。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : {s}Help.{/s} Yeah, that sounds good to me. Lead the way, Miku.
lines.zh: : {s}救命{/s}。嗯，我觉得挺好的。你带路吧，Miku。

lines.en: {i}We make our way back into the karaoke booth where the best chapter started. It’s chapter four and it’s home to the supreme leader, Hyphen-Knight.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我们走回那间卡拉 OK 包厢——最好的一章就是从这里开始的。那是第四章，也是最高领袖 Hyphen-Knight 的家。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Hyphen-Knight is super cool and always makes me do the right thing. Right, buddybug?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Hyphen-Knight 超酷，而且总是让我做正确的事。对吧，小老弟虫？{/i}

lines.en: : {s}I NEED TO LEAVE.{/s} Sorry for acting weird before, you two. I just haven’t done anything like this since I was young and I’m...not sure if I even remember how.
lines.zh: : {s}我得走了{/s}。抱歉之前表现得怪怪的，你们俩。我只是很久没做过这种事了，从我很年轻那会儿起就……我不确定自己还记不记得该怎么玩。

lines.en: : Hm? Thought you came here all the time with Ami, Ayane, and {b}MAYA.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯？我还以为你以前老跟 Ami、Ayane 和 {b}MAYA{/b} 来呢。

lines.en: CENSOR HER NAME. I’VE BEEN DOING SO WELL.
lines.zh: 屏蔽她的名字。我一直做得挺好的。

lines.en: {i}Oooooooooooh MAYA. I could have sworn it was Mayo. My bad, man. Let me just make some adjustments really quick.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}噢——————是 MAYA 啊。我还以为你说的是 Mayo 呢。我的错，老兄。我马上调整一下。{/i}

lines.en: : Shhhh...Talking will just make me angry. My defining characteristic is my feigned disdain for you and the never-ending facade that I will fare better without your penis inside of me.
lines.zh: : 嘘……你说话只会让我生气。我的标志性特征，就是假装嫌弃你，以及那层永远卸不下来的伪装——没有你的阴茎在我体内，我会过得更好。

lines.en: : She’s right, Akirensei. Doodly-boodly-bop-boop. Let’s fuck.
lines.zh: : 她说得对，Akirensei。嘟哩-布哩-啵-噗。来干吧。

lines.en: {i}Wait, hold on. Karin needs more lines or this won’t count as one of her events anymore.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}等等，等一下。Karin 得多说几句，不然这就不能算她的事件了。{/i}
: 大家好！我们是 Karin！

lines.en: : We will make an excellent mother if you embed your sperms into us! Do that now, please!
lines.zh: : 只要你把精子种进我们体内，我们一定会成为出色的母亲！现在就做吧，拜托了！
: 你为什么要这么做？……
: 做什么？

lines.en: : {s}Hurting me.{/i} I just don’t understand why you’d invite someone like {i}me{/i} out to do something so fun...I’m boring. Nobody likes me.
lines.zh: : {s}伤害我。{/s}我只是不明白，你为什么会约{i}我{/i}这样的人出来做这么好玩的事……我很无聊。没人喜欢我。

lines.en: : That ain’t true at all, Sensei. Me and Karin both think you’re pretty swell and-
lines.zh: : 完全没有这回事，Sensei。我和 Karin 都觉得你挺好的，而且——
: 啊！等一下。
: 啊，糟了！我完全忘了！

lines.en: : ...No, I can run! Gimme fifteen minutes! Sorry, Io!
lines.zh: : ……不，我可以跑过去！给我十五分钟！对不起，Io！

lines.en: : Guys, I totally forgot I already made plans with Io and Uta. So I’ve gotta run. Literally.
lines.zh: : 各位，我完全忘了我早就跟 Io 和 Uta 约好了。所以我得跑了。字面意义上的跑。

lines.en: : Sensei, you can walk Karin home, right? We can’t be lettin’ strangers get ahold’a those bazongas.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你能送 Karin 回家吧？我们可不能让陌生人碰那对波霸。

lines.en: : I can walk myself home. It’s not {i}that{/i} late. And besides, how can someone grab ahold of a kind and gentle demeanor?
lines.zh: : 我自己能走回去。天还不算晚。再说了，谁又能抓住一个善良温柔的气质呢？
{i}准备给她看看你的兄弟了吗？哈哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {s}THAT’S NOT WHAT THAT MEANS.{/s} Yeah, that’s no problem at all. Have fun with dorm 7, Miku. And tell them I miss them while you’re at it.
lines.zh: : {s}根本不是那个意思{/s}。行，完全没问题。替我向 7 号宿舍的各位问好，Miku。顺便告诉他们我想他们了。
: {i}收到！再见啦，各位！抱歉！{/i}

lines.en: : That Miku. She’s always so unpredictable.
lines.zh: : 这个 Miku。她总是这么捉摸不定。

lines.en: : I guess we should probably g...get going then! Right?
lines.zh: : 那我们大概也该……该走了吧！对吧？

lines.en: : After all, it wouldn’t be acceptable for you and I to be alone at such a...
lines.zh: : 毕竟，你我孤男寡女待在这么一个……
: Sensei……你还好吗？

lines.en: : {s}NO.{/s} Actually...there’s something I’ve been wanting to tell you.
lines.zh: : {s}不好{/s}。其实……有件事我一直想告诉你。
: 什么事……你一直……

lines.en: : {s}GET OUT OF MY FUCKING HEAD.{/s} Yeah...it’s kind of embarrassing, though...so...I might need a minute to, like...figure out the right way to say it.
lines.zh: : {s}从我他妈的脑子里滚出去{/s}。嗯……不过这事有点难为情……所以……我可能需要一点时间，那个……想想要怎么开口。

lines.en: {i}Take all the time that you need! It’s not like any of this is real anyway.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}慢慢来，要多久都行！反正这一切又不是真的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I mean, consequences in a game world? Where you can just manually rewrite all the things that you’ve done if you don’t reach your desired outcome? There’s no point to any of it!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我是说，游戏世界里谈什么后果？只要结果不如意，你手动把做过的事全改写一遍不就行了？这一切根本毫无意义！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Which means that even if you turn the music up really loud to prevent anyone from hearing her screams,  you can always go back to a world before she screamed!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}也就是说，就算你把音乐开到最大，好让谁都听不见她的尖叫，你也随时能回到她尖叫之前的世界！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Granted, I’ll just force you here again the next time you try to pick up where you left off from, so you’re kinda screwed anyway if you’re genuinely trying to avoid that.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}当然，下次你想从上次的进度接着玩，我还是会把你按回这里，所以你要是真想躲，反正也是白搭。{/i}

lines.en: {i}That’s right! This is another one of those “unavoidable outcomes” we’ve all been pushing you toward. But we’re doing that for a reason, Akira.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}没错！这就是我们一直推着你去撞的那些「不可避免的结局」之一。但我们这么做是有理由的，Akira。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You see, there are these things we in the office call “landmarks.” They’re points a person has to see before they die. Like Kiyomizu-dera for the Japanese or an “Arby’s” for Americans.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你看，我们办公室里管这些东西叫「地标」。就是一个人死之前必须去看的地方。对日本人来说是清水寺，对美国人来说是一家「Arby's」。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And as you venture from point A to point B and then C and D and blah, blah, blah, we gain good-boy points that we can redeem for prizes.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}等你从 A 点走到 B 点，再到 C 点、D 点，吧啦吧啦吧啦，我们就能攒下好孩子积分，可以兑换奖品。{/i}
{i}这倒提醒我了！{/i}
{i}Karin 的好感度提升到了 [karin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Hell yeah. I wasn’t sure if that would work or not. This was my first time trying.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}太爽了。我本来还不确定这招行不行。这可是我第一次试。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I’m improving really quickly, right? Are you proud of me? Do you understand my power now? Do you see why they were keeping me hidden?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我进步得很快吧？你为我骄傲吗？现在你明白我的力量了吗？明白他们为什么一直把我藏着了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : It’s a pretty douche move to pull the same trick twice, you know.
lines.zh: : 同一个把戏使两次，挺混蛋的，你知道吗。

lines.en: {i}But that wasn’t me last time. It was the ///////////////// guy.{/i}
: I thought it was the caps lock guy?
lines.zh: : 我还以为是大写锁定那家伙？

lines.en: {i}Because he wanted you to think it was the caps lock guy. God, get with the program already.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为他就是想让你以为是大写锁定那家伙。天啊，跟上节奏行不行。{/i}

lines.en: : Who was the “take something that doesn’t belong to you” one then? Because that’s the one I hate the most.
lines.zh: : 那「拿走不属于你的东西」那个是谁？因为我最恨的就是那个。

lines.en: {i}All of us. All of us do everything. God, you’re so fucking dumb. Pay attention.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}全都是我们。我们什么都干。天啊，你怎么这么他妈的蠢。专心点。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m trying, it’s just that this is all so fucking confusing.
lines.zh: : 我在努力了，只是这一切都他妈的太难懂了。

lines.en: {i}Welcome to faith, frog boy. Things won’t ever make sense if you keep trying to MAKE them make sense. Logic is the arch-nemesis of art, after all.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}欢迎来到信仰的世界，青蛙小子。你要是一直想把事情硬掰出个道理，那它们永远都不会有道理。毕竟逻辑是艺术的老对头。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You’re paying the price for that now by proceeding despite all of the warnings you were given that all it would bring is ruin. But now you won’t stop CRYING about that ruin.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你现在就在为此付出代价——那么多警告都告诉你，继续下去只会带来毁灭，你偏要往前走。而现在你又为这毁灭哭个没完。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You humans are so fucking hypocritical all the time. You want and you want and you want, but whenever WE ask for anything, it’s always, “GOD is evil! God is bad!{/i}”
lines.zh: {i}你们人类永远都这么他妈的虚伪。你们要、要、要，可一旦我们开口要点什么，就永远是「上帝是邪恶的！上帝是坏的！」{/i}

lines.en: {i}Imagine you find a roach in your cereal one day and that roach fucking bites you and it lays its eggs in the bite hole and then gets pissed at you for trying to get them out. That’s what you’re doing.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}想象一下，有一天你在麦片里发现一只蟑螂，那蟑螂他妈的咬了你一口，还把卵产进咬出来的洞里，然后因为你想把卵挖出来而冲你发火。你现在干的就是这种事。{/i}

lines.en: : So you think making me force myself on girls will somehow clean the wound?
lines.zh: : 所以你觉得，逼我去强暴那些女孩，就能把伤口清理干净？

lines.en: {i}No. I just want a taste of that sweet pusssaaaaaaaaaay.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不。我只是想尝尝那甜美的逼——————。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I follow Akira out into the hall as he attempts to flee from an opportunity to cash in all of his Karin fuck-points and barricade him in with a bunch of Mikus and an artistic rendering of Mayo. Sorry- Maya.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我跟着 Akira 走进走廊——他正试图逃离这个能把所有「Karin 操点」兑现的机会——然后用一堆 Miku 和一幅 Mayo 的艺术画像把他堵在中间。抱歉——是 Maya。{/i}

lines.en: : Hi, I’m Maya — the main heroine of Lessons in Love. I do the time thing.
lines.zh: : 你好，我是 Maya——《Lessons in Love》的女主角。我负责时间这档子事。
: 现在不了，你不负责了。
: 大手指。插进阴道。
: 肩膀怎么了？
: 浮游花。专心点。

lines.en: : Hi, I’m Maya — the main heroine of Lessons in Love. You killed me. You killed me, Akira. Millions of years of memories, stripped away by a one night stand. Way to go. What a way to end things.
lines.zh: : 你好，我是 Maya——《Lessons in Love》的女主角。你杀了我。你杀了我，Akira。几百万年的记忆，被一夜情抹得一干二净。干得漂亮。这收尾方式可真行。

lines.en: : I NEVER WANTED TO END THINGS. I NEVER WANTED TO DO THAT.
lines.zh: : 我从来没想过要结束这一切。我从来没想过要那么做。

lines.en: {i}You sooooo wanted to do that. You’ve been jerking off to her from the start.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你他———妈的想那么做。你从一开始就在对着她打飞机。{/i}

lines.en: : BUT IF I KNEW THE CONSEQUENCES-
lines.zh: : 可如果我知道后果——

lines.en: {i}See- that’s what makes you SO FUCKING ANNOYING.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}瞧——这就是你他妈的烦人的地方。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Consequences, this. Consequences, that. You know who DIDN’T care about consequences? Your first love. That girl was ready to DIE for what she believed in.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}后果这啊后果那的。你知道谁不在乎后果吗？你的初恋。那个女孩愿意为她相信的东西去死。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Unfortunately, she wound up dying for other reasons. But alas, it is always the good ones who are taken from us.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不幸的是，她最后是因为别的原因死的。但唉，被带走的总是好人。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Personally, I feel the worst for whoever it was who had to do her autopsy. So many pieces to sort through. Some from different puzzles!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我个人最同情的，是那个不得不给她做尸检的人。要整理的碎片实在太多了。有些还是来自不同的拼图！{/i}

lines.en: {i}But that’s okay. In a miraculous turn of events, some of those pieces were still functional. And YOU’RE still functional too! You just pretend not to be because you’re a wimpy pansypants.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过没关系。奇迹般的转折是，其中有些碎片还能用。而你也还能用！你只是装作不能用，因为你是个没种的娘娘腔。{/i}

lines.en: : Hi, I’m Maya — the main heroine of Lessons in Love. I like watermelons.
lines.zh: : 你好，我是 Maya——《Lessons in Love》的女主角。我喜欢西瓜。

lines.en: {i}Jesus Christ, does she always talk this much?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}天啊，她话一直这么多吗？{/i}
: 把她带回来就行……
: 我什么都愿意做……
: 什么都愿意！

lines.en: : YES! ANYTHING! WHAT DO YOU WANT?
lines.zh: : 对！什么都愿意！你想要什么？

lines.en: {i}The same thing all of us want — a chance.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}和我们所有人想要的一样——一个机会。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Fill her with your seed so that I may sing again.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}用你的种子填满她，好让我能再次歌唱。{/i}
: 求你别伤害我。

lines.en: {i}And in the event that she’s infertile, I can learn to adjust.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}万一她不能生育，我也学得会变通。{/i}
{i}我可以吞噬她。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Remove her fingers one by one and put them in your mouth.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}把她的手指一根一根摘下来，放进你嘴里。{/i}

lines.en: {i}If that won’t work, remove her tongue. A voice, she’ll live without.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果那也不行，就割掉她的舌头。没有声音，她照样能活。{/i}

lines.en: {i}For in its place of loneliness, that oral cave of doubt.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为在那孤独的位置上，是那充满疑虑的口腔洞穴。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Sits confidence and character — that desolate ole’ drouth.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}坐着自信与品格——那片荒芜的久旱之地。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You’re not the only one who knows how to rhyme.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}会押韵的不止你一个。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You’re just the only one who can hear them.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你只是唯一一个听得见它们的人。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And that’s just one more reason we’ll be such good friends.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而这不过是我们能成为好朋友的又一个理由。{/i}

lines.en: : Do you ever dream of me?
lines.zh: : 你有没有梦见过我？
: Sensei……
: 你有……对吧？
: 求你……别这样……

lines.en: : What am I like there? Inside of your head.
lines.zh: : 在那里我是什么样的？在你脑子里。

lines.en: : Is it better or worse than who I am on the outside?
lines.zh: : 是比外面的我更好，还是更糟？

lines.en: : And do you wish you could take me in?
lines.zh: : 还有，你希不希望把我接纳进去？
: 因为你可以。

lines.en: : I can be gentle if I have to.
lines.zh: : 如果需要的话，我可以很温柔。

lines.en: : I can start with your mouth.
lines.zh: : 我可以从你的嘴开始。
: 我的……

lines.en: : I can touch you head to toe.
lines.zh: : 我可以从头到脚地摸遍你。

lines.en: : I’m so good at keeping secrets, love.
lines.zh: : 我最会保守秘密了，亲爱的。

lines.en: : No one ever has to know.
lines.zh: : 永远都不会有人知道。
: 你为什么要这么做？……
: 是我做错了什么吗？……
: 如果我做错了……那对不起……
你什么都没做错。
我只是想尝一口。
: 我还没准备好……
: 你不喜欢我吗，Karin？

lines.en: : Don’t you want to understand the world your sister sees?
lines.zh: : 你难道不想理解你妹妹眼中的世界吗？
: 不要以这种方式……
: 不想？
: 我不想要这样……
: 我想要。
: Karin……
: Sensei……求你了……
{i}Karin 的欲望提升到了 1!{/i}
: ……Karin？
: 发生……什么了？……
: 没……没事！我没事！什么都没……发生！我……没事！
: Karin，你吓到我了。
: 声……声音！很大的……声音！完全没事！只是……声音而已！

lines.en: : That’s right! Just...a noise! Nothing...to worry about!
lines.zh: : 就是这样！只是……一个声音！没什么……好担心的！
: 哈哈！哈哈哈哈！
: 哈哈……哈啊……
: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊——————！！！KIRIN！！！！！！！！！！！！！
: 嘿！没事了……没事了……
: 一切都好……

lines.en: : What did you make me do?
lines.zh: : 你让我做了什么？

lines.en: {i}Me? I didn’t MAKE you do anything. You’re just a creepy pervert who got a little impulsive.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我？我可没「让」你做任何事。你只是个一时冲动的恶心变态。{/i}
: 是你逼我压到她身上的。

lines.en: {i}YOU forced YOURSELF onto her. I just watched.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}是你自己逼自己压上去的。我只是在旁边看。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Besides! You wound up letting her go in the end. No harm, no foul, right?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}再说了！你最后不是放她走了吗。没造成伤害就不算犯规，对吧？{/i}

lines.en: : SHUT UP! SHUT UP, SHUT UP, SHUT UP! GET OUT OF MY HOUSE!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！闭嘴，闭嘴，闭嘴！滚出我家！

lines.en: : Jeez, where’d {i}that{/i} attitude come from? Bad day at the office, baby?
lines.zh: 天哪，{i}这{/i}脾气哪来的？办公室里不顺心吗，宝贝？
: 滚！你们两个都滚！现在！

lines.en: {i}What’s the big deal, man? She wasn’t being serious when she said no. She was just playing hard to get. That’s how girls are these days.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有什么大不了的，老兄？她说不要又不是认真的。她只是在欲擒故纵。现在的女孩子都这样。{/i}

lines.en: : THAT ISN’T TRUE! STOP MAKING ME DO THESE THINGS TO PEOPLE WHO DON’T DESERVE THEM!
lines.zh: : 才不是这样！别再逼我对那些不该承受这些的人做这种事！
{i}行吧行吧。天哪。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I’ll just have to find somebody who does.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那我就只能去找个该承受的人了。{/i}
{i}Karin 的好感度下降了 1,000,010!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Oh, and her lust never actually went up. I was just fucking with you. {/i}
lines.zh: {i}哦对了，她的欲望其实根本没涨。我只是逗你玩的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Had you going, though, didn’t I? LOL!{i}
lines.zh: {i}不过还真把你骗到了吧？哈哈哈！{/i}

lines.en: I’ve been talking to myself a lot lately.
lines.zh: 最近我老是跟自己说话。

lines.en: I wish I knew how to make it stop.
lines.zh: 我真希望知道该怎么让它停下来。
{i}Akira 获得了状态效果 [[PARANOID]！{/i}
